# Get coordinates of weather stations with visibility data
query_ws_coords = text("""

""")

# Get coordinates of all air quality stations

SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
""")
aq_coords = pd.read_sql(query_aq_coords, engine)
print("\nAir quality stations:")
print(aq_coords)

# Compute haversine distances to find nearest air quality station for each weather station
def haversine(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2):
    R = 6371000  # metres
    phi1 = np.radians(lat1)
    phi2 = np.radians(lat2)
    dphi = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlambda = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = np.sin(dphi/2)**2 + np.cos(phi1)*np.cos(phi2)*np.sin(dlambda/2)**2
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1-a))
    return R * c

print("\nDistances from weather stations to air quality stations:")

    print(f"\n{ws_row['name_en']} (id={ws_row['id']}):")

        dist = haversine(ws_row['lon'], ws_row['lat'], aq_row['lon'], aq_row['lat'])
        if dist < 5000:  # Only show stations within 5km
            print(f"  -> {aq_row['name_en']} (id={aq_row['id']}): {dist:.0f}m")
